description:
T1 – Apple Malus domestica
Proposed Works:
	•	Reduce excessive upright (vertical) growth to rebalance the crown.
	•	Selectively prune lateral branches to improve overall form, symmetry, and structural integrity.
	•	Retain and encourage fruiting wood to maintain fruit production potential.

Reason:
To improve crown structure, balance, and long-term health while maintaining the tree’s amenity value and fruiting capability.



T2 – Pear Pyrus communis
Proposed Works:
	•	Reduce dominant upright growth.
	•	Selectively prune lateral branches to reshape and refine the canopy.
	•	Improve internal light penetration and airflow throughout the crown.

Reason:
To enhance tree health and vigour, reduce congestion within the canopy, and promote sustainable growth and fruiting.



Front Garden

T3 – Lime Tillia species
Proposed Works:
	•	Pollard back to previous, established pollard points only.
	•	No new pollard points to be created.

Reason:
To maintain the tree within its established pollarding cycle, ensuring continued vitality, structural safety, and a consistent form appropriate to its location.
